Content: [ThinkingBlock(signature='', thinking='This is a simple addition problem. Let me work through it step by step.\n\n12 + 12\n\nI can think of this in several ways:\n\nMethod 1: Simple addition\n12 + 12 = 24\n\nMethod 2: Breaking it down\n12 + 12 = (10 + 2) + (10 + 2)\n= (10 + 10) + (2 + 2)\n= 20 + 4\n= 24\n\nMethod 3: Counting by 12s\nStarting at 12, add another 12: 12 → 24\n\nAll methods give us 24.', type='thinking'), TextBlock(citations=None, text='# 12 + 12 = ?\n\nLet me solve this step by step:\n\n**Step 1:** Break down each number into tens and ones\n- 12 = 10 + 2\n- 12 = 10 + 2\n\n**Step 2:** Add the tens together\n- 10 + 10 = 20\n\n**Step 3:** Add the ones together\n- 2 + 2 = 4\n\n**Step 4:** Combine the results\n- 20 + 4 = **24**\n\nTherefore, **12 + 12 = 24**', type='text')]
